about: The dock's Trash answers a drag it would take as a Mac's Dock does (docs/adr/0044-system-sounds.mdx, docs/adr/0035-drag-and-drop.mdx): sample/DragProbe.tsx (Allo) drags a file of the run's home through the platform's drag and holds it over the Trash for a second. Its picture darkens (`dock-trash-shade`'s opacity from 0 to exactly 0.35, only ever rising) and it grows a little on a spring that never passes its end (`dock-trash-scale`'s scale from 1 to exactly 1.1, only ever rising); Escape cancels the drag and both go back, only ever falling, to exactly 0 and 1. Nothing is moved and no sound plays. Then the file held over it and dropped: the same up and back, the file in the home's Trash and gone from the home, and the session plays the Trash's sound (`file-trash`) exactly once. At scale 1.25 (a 1600x1000 display, 1280x800 logical).

steps.name: a file held over the Trash a second, then Escape: it darkens and grows a little, then both go back; nothing is moved, nothing sounds
held over the Trash and dropped: it darkens and grows a little, then both go back; the file is in the home's Trash and the Trash's sound plays once
